title: Book One · Chapter 73: The New Shelf
story:
After the short school break, Ronan has a different classroom.

The window is on the other side. The shelf for their bags is higher. He is seven now. He still has to stand on his toes to reach the top space.

Leo puts his bag there at once.

“I can reach yours too,” he says.

“I can do it.”

Ronan pushes. His bag catches on the edge. A book drops out and lands open on the floor.

Mei picks it up before anyone steps on it.

“Or use this space,” she says. She points to the lower shelf.

“I wanted the top.”

“So did my bag. It will have to get used to this one.”

She puts her own bag in the middle. Ronan moves his below hers. Leo keeps his bag in the top space.

Miss Wu writes three questions on the board. She is their teacher again. Ronan is glad she is their teacher again. He is less glad about the child beside him. That child taps the desk with a ruler.

What floats?

What sinks?

How can we find out?

Miss Wu is still writing the last line. Leo raises his hand already.

“A ship floats.”

“Usually,” Miss Wu says. “What can we put in a basin in this room?”

“A very small ship.”

Several children laugh. Miss Wu smiles, then points at the empty table by the window.

“This term we shall make small boats. First we shall look and test. We shall watch the tests. Then we shall write the results.”

Ronan thinks of his wooden boat at home. He wants to bring it and finish before everyone else.

Miss Wu gives each child a page. There is a space for a drawing, a space for words, and one small box at the bottom.

“What goes there?” Ronan asks.

“Write a question there.”

He writes: Can I bring my boat?

The child beside him taps the ruler five more times. Ronan puts a finger on it. The child pulls it away.

“Please stop,” Ronan whispers. “I cannot think.”

The child puts the ruler across the open book instead. The room is quieter.

When Miss Wu reaches Ronan, she reads his question.

“You may show it another day,” she says. “For our tests, everyone will use the materials here. Everyone will work with those materials. I will watch your tests.”

He looks at the empty drawing space. He still needs to make and test a class boat. He has no result to write on this page yet.

At the end, he takes his bag from the low shelf. He does not drop anything. Another bag fell sideways on the top shelf. Leo has to lift his own bag over it.

“Still want the top?” Leo asks.

“Perhaps when I am taller.”

Before he leaves, Ronan checks the lower shelf. The space is dry and close to his hand. He writes his name on a scrap of paper. He folds it and puts it inside his space. Tomorrow he can find that space again. The child with the ruler asks, “Is the next space free?” Ronan says yes. Someone left a shoe across both spaces. Together the children move it aside. The ruler stays in the other child's bag this time.

Outside, Mum asks about the new room. Ronan tells her about the basin and the questions.

“Did you make a boat?”

“Not yet.”

“What did you make?”

He shows her the page. He tells her the three questions on the board. In the small box, Miss Wu wrote one short answer: Show us on Friday.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- float＝浮起
- sink＝下沉
- find out＝弄清楚
- materials＝材料

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：term＝学期；basin＝盆；scrap＝小片纸。

## 读句提示

**Then we shall write the results.**

然后／我们会写下／结果。先观察，后记录。

## 理解问题

1. MissWu为什么不让Ronan直接用家里的木船完成测试？
2. 新教室的架子怎样带来一个小问题？
